title: Drone survey shows rust-like lines and cracks on the object

tellings.quote: We saw some weird lines. Yeah. Some cracks. Yeah. And something I would say it was like rust. Like metal.

plain: A 2025 survey with an underwater drone showed strange lines, cracks and what looked like rust, like metal, on a large shape lying on the floor of the Baltic Sea, says Dennis Asberg, the treasure hunter who found it. Asberg says he saw the footage himself, and he offers it as a sign that the shape may be a made object rather than rock.
